::: {.callout-important}
### Headline Finding
In multimodal policy fine-tuning, standard task success ($\text{SR}$) can completely conceal behavioral collapse. Plain DSRL scores $\text{SR} = 1.000$, but collapses to a single mode ($\text{SR}_M = 0.250, \text{mcf} = 1/4$).
:::

## 1. The Core Tension: Stability vs. Mode Discovery

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Pretrained Policy f₀] -->|DSRL / ReinFlow without anchor| B[Mode Collapse: 1/4 Modes]
    A -->|Functional Anchor: Paired Noise| C[Mode Preservation: 4/4 Modes]
    A -->|BMD: Mutual Information| D[Mode Discovery: Shifted Goals]
    C & D --> E[BMD + Anchor: Robust Multimodal Generalization]
```

## 2. Quantitative Results

| Method | Environment | Task Success ($\text{SR}$) | Balanced Success ($\text{SR}_M$) | Reliable Modes ($\text{mcf}$) | Entropy ($H_s / \log M$) |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Plain DSRL | $g_2$ | 1.000 | 0.250 | 1.00 | 0.000 |
| Full BMD | $g_2$ | 0.976 | 0.797 | 3.12 | 0.793 |
| **BMD + Anchor** | $g_2$ | **0.9995** | **0.968** | **3.88** | **0.910** |
| Plain DSRL | $g_5$ | 0.9995 | 0.250 | 1.00 | 0.000 |
| **Functional Anchor** | $g_5$ | **0.993** | **0.993** | **4.00** | **0.978** |

## 3. The Functional Anchor Formulation

Given input noise $\varepsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(0, I)$ and pretrained generator $f_0(s, \varepsilon)$:

$$
\mathcal{L}_{\text{anchor}}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{s \sim \mathcal{D}, \varepsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(0, I)} \left\| f_\theta(s, \varepsilon) - f_0(s, \varepsilon) \right\|^2
$$

::: {.callout-note}
Notice that $f_0$ receives the exact same noise realization $\varepsilon$ as $f_\theta$. This couples the latent noise coordinates to the original behavioral basins.
:::
